note: Glass-of-water cascade, stage 2 (micro band). Consumes the nano stage's micro_mass_density + micro_cohesion_index. Mass density is scale-invariant so it passes through unchanged (identity, grounded). The cohesion index (measured H-bond coordination, ~4.5 for liquid water) is normalised toward an O(1) cohesion strength (weight 1/4.5 = 0.2222) that the macro stage turns into surface tension / viscosity. ILLUSTRATIVE normalisation (labelled): it sets the RELATIVE cohesion the macro solver feels, not a metrological surface tension. Real stages are trained per band via trech-train-surrogate.
